relevance_note: Case report of one family in which the proband and his father carry a heterozygous deletion of TNFAIP3 exons 2-9 ("拷贝数变异分析发现先证者及其父亲存在TNFAIP3外显子2~9杂合缺失") and are diagnosed with A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20), with individual-level clinical detail.
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema and the rules. No table was transcribed by script; the paper's only table (附表1, 19 published TNFAIP3 CNV cases) is not present in the Markdown, so those patients are recorded only where the text gives individual detail (refs [6], [9], [20]); the other published cases and the three further families reported only as groups get no rows, and 19 is not entered as cohort_size_as_stated because the authors state it as the number of previously published CNV cases, not as the size of this study (n_patients_reported = 2, from "患儿及其父亲诊断为A20单倍剂量不足（HA20）"). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients = false: the paper never says its own two patients were reported earlier. Labels: Ⅲ-4 and Ⅱ-4 are the paper's own pedigree labels; relatives without an own label follow rule 2 ("家系中其他成员 of Ⅲ-4", "mother of ref [9] patient", "哥哥 of ref [20] patient") and literature patients follow rule 4 ("ref [9] patient", "ref [20] patient", "ref [6] patient"). Uncertainties: (1) "家系中其他成员无发热、腹泻、腹痛、口腔溃疡、关节炎等临床表现" names no individual and gives no count, so these family members share one row ("家系中其他成员 of Ⅲ-4"); (2) the proband's mother underwent trio exome sequencing (抽取先证者及其父母外周静脉血3 mL) but no individual result is stated for her, so she got no row; (3) perianal ulcer (肛周溃疡) was kept as its own feature and not mapped onto the checklist item "genital ulcers"; (4) normal findings at a single time point (口腔黏膜未见溃疡 at admission, 未见溃疡、息肉及肿瘤 at follow-up colonoscopy) were not treated as excluding the recurrent oral ulcers and colorectal ulcers reported earlier, so those checklist items are observed; (5) variant_type "large deletion/CNV" and zygosity "heterozygous" come from the authors' own wording "拷贝数变异（杂合缺失）"; (6) excluded rows keep the paper's own words for normal findings, and for the father the colonoscopy sentence is recorded exactly as printed.
